The website claims to offer laser teeth whitening, but the treatment actually provided uses LED whitening technology, not a laser.

This is misleading and can confuse patients.

For cosmetic and medical services, clear and accurate information is essential. Presenting LED whitening as laser treatment creates incorrect expectations about results, treatment time, and effectiveness.

Adding proper explanations on the website would improve transparency and help maintain client trust.
To clarify the difference in quality and performance:

LED Whitening Technology
☆ Uses LED light to activate whitening gel
☆ Produces gradual whitening results
☆ Requires multiple sessions for noticeable change
☆ Lower risk of tooth sensitivity
☆ Generally considered a cosmetic whitening method

Laser Whitening Technology
☆ Uses medical-grade laser energy
☆ Delivers faster and stronger whitening results
☆ Often achieves visible results in one session
☆ Typically performed under professional dental supervision
☆ Considered a higher-grade clinical whitening treatment

In terms of overall effectiveness, laser whitening is generally recognized as the higher-quality and stronger treatment, while LED whitening offers gentler but more moderate results.

Clearly stating which technology is being used would allow clients to make informed decisions and would significantly improve credibility and trust.
